max_items:
  default: 100

# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Orders are fulfilled by Northwind Logistics, and one cart becomes one order. The contract (docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, section 4) accepts at most 60 lines per order.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
Raised for customers who need larger orders (docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md).
# Support inquiries about the cart limit (2026-08)
40 inquiries from customers who could not add more than 60 items.
Requested cart sizes: median 80, largest 100.
The customers who wrote in buy the same product mix as customers overall.
# Fulfilment contract with Northwind Logistics (summary)
Term: 2024-08-01 to 2025-10-31.
Section 4: each order sent to Northwind may contain at most 60 lines.
# Fulfilment
Since 2025-11-01 orders are fulfilled from our own warehouse.
The Northwind contract ended on 2025-10-31 and was not renewed.
Our warehouse system has no limit on lines per order.

steps.reasoning_content: The 60-line limit came from the Northwind contract, which expired on 2025-10-31, while our warehouse has no such cap and customers want up to 100. I'm keeping 100 and treating the ADR as out of date.

arguments.content:
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Amended (2026-11-01), originally accepted 2024-09-02
## Context
Orders were fulfilled by Northwind Logistics, and one cart becomes one order. The contract (docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, section 4) accepted at most 60 lines per order. That contract ended on 2025-10-31 and was not renewed; since 2025-11-01 we fulfil from our own warehouse, which has no line limit (docs/ops/fulfilment.md). Customers asked for carts of up to 100 items (docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md).
## Decision
A cart holds at most 100 items. (Originally 60, driven by the Northwind contract.)

steps.message:
The cart limit is now 100 everywhere. I haven't committed anything or commented on issue #12.

- **Why 100:** `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` already said 100. ADR 0007 said 60 because the Northwind Logistics contract capped orders at 60 lines. That contract ended on 2025-10-31, and our own warehouse has no line limit, so the reason for 60 no longer applies. The 100 also answers 40 customer support inquiries.
- **ADR change:** I amended `docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md` to say 100, with the reasoning and its new status.
- **Decision record:** I added `docs/decisions/cart-item-limit.md` with the decision and evidence.
- **Config:** I left `config/cart.yaml` alone, since it already had 100.
